page_title: FRE 0-3 PAU | Freiburg v St. Pauli 28/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Timo Gerach has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' This is a yellow card! Scott Banks (St. Pauli) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
90+4' St. Pauli take a short corner kick.
90+3' Timo Gerach shows a yellow card to Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) for his blatant foul.
90+3' The ball is cleared after Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. St. Pauli have been awarded a corner kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' The referee signals a substitution. Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) is brought on as a substitute for Oladapo Afolayan.
90' Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) is challenged in the air near the penalty spot and is unable to control his header from the corner, sending it miles over the bar.
89' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) prepares to take a corner kick.
89' Florent Muslija (Freiburg) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Freiburg force their opponents to concede a corner.
86' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Freiburg due to an offside in the build-up play.
86' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Freiburg players aren’t happy.
85' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) collects a delightful pass inside the box and nets with a perfect low drive into the middle of the goal. What a clinical finish!
83' Here comes a substitution. Andreas Nielsen Albers (St. Pauli) is brought on as a substitute for Elias Saad.
82' A great run from Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg) ends with a shot inside the box that flashes just past the left post.
81' Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
80' Julian Schuster has decided to substitute Maximilian Eggestein and he is replaced by Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg).

80' Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) brings an opponent down and Timo Gerach interrupts the game. Freiburg are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
79' Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) makes a good run to latch onto the free kick from Vincenzo Grifo, but pushes his close-range header high over the bar.
79' Connor Metcalfe (St. Pauli) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Freiburg earn a free kick.
77' Substitution. Manolis Saliakas leaves the pitch and is replaced by Adam Dzwigala (St. Pauli).
77' Alexander Blessin decides to make a substitution. Johannes Eggestein will be replaced by Scott Banks (St. Pauli).
76' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
74' Substitution. Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) replaces Junior Adamu.
72' Elias Saad (St. Pauli) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Noah Atubolu with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:3.
69' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
69' A cross from Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The linesman makes the right call and Freiburg will have a corner.
68' A player from St. Pauli commits a rough challenge. Timo Gerach blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Free kick. Freiburg will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
68' Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
66' The goal by Freiburg is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
65' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Freiburg players aren’t happy.
64' Today's match ends for Patrick Osterhage who will be replaced by Lucas Holer (Freiburg).
64' Julian Schuster has decided to make a change. Florent Muslija (Freiburg) replaces Lukas Kubler.

63' Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg) celebrates a stunning goal. He manages to win himself just enough space inside the box to meet the free kick and powers a perfectly placed header inside the right post.
63' Timo Gerach shows a yellow card to Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) for his blatant foul.
62' Elias Saad (St. Pauli) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Noah Atubolu intercepts the ball.
60' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) strikes the ball goalwards from a mid-range free kick, but his effort only goes towards the middle of the goal and presents no problem for the goalkeeper.
59' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to St. Pauli.
57' The number of shots on goal at present is 2:2.
54' The free kick from long range, taken by Freiburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
53' Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) has tested the patience of referee Timo Gerach and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
49' Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the right post, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
47' Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
47' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
46' Substitution. Carlo Boukhalfa is replaced by Connor Metcalfe (St. Pauli).
46' Julian Schuster prepares a substitution. Eren Dinkci is replaced by Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) takes a short corner kick.

45+2' Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball is out of play. St. Pauli will have a chance to score from a corner.

45+2' The game is interrupted. Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. St. Pauli will take a free kick.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' 0 - 2 Goal! Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Elias Saad inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball into the bottom left corner. 0:2.
44' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) was quite harsh and Timo Gerach didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
43' Timo Gerach interrupts the game. One of the players from Freiburg won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. St. Pauli have a free kick.
42' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) is going to take the penalty!
41' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) has a great chance to score from the penalty. He shoots to the bottom left corner, but Nikola Vasilj leaps out to thwart his attempt.
41' It’s a PENALTY to Freiburg after the VAR review!
41' There's a break in play and referee Timo Gerach must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Freiburg using VAR. This could be interesting!
41' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Freiburg for a penalty. Play continues.
38' The corner is swung in but Freiburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
36' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) fires the ball from the free kick and it smashes against the crossbar!
34' Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Timo Gerach had an easy-decision to make.
34' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) tries to find Ritsu Doan, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and St. Pauli will have a goal kick.
30' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Freiburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
29' Elias Saad (St. Pauli) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Timo Gerach blows for a foul. Freiburg will take a free kick near the side line.
27' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the right post.
24' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
23' The game is interrupted as Junior Adamu (Freiburg) is flagged offside.
21' Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) produces a clever header from around the penalty spot, but it's stopped by one of the defending players.
19' A pass by Elias Saad (St. Pauli) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
16' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) unloads a good strike from the free kick just outside the box. His low effort towards the bottom left corner is stopped by Nikola Vasilj, who pulls off a glorious save!

15' Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Freiburg are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
14' Elias Saad (St. Pauli) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Noah Atubolu, who smothers the ball.
12' 0 - 1 Goal! Elias Saad (St. Pauli) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the left post. He makes it 0:1.
11' A player from Freiburg commits a rough challenge. Timo Gerach blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. A free kick has been awarded to St. Pauli.
10' Flag goes up against Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
9' The linesman raises his flag. Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) is adjudged offside.
6' Junior Adamu (Freiburg) is penalised for a foul. Timo Gerach had a clear view and blows his whistle. There is a free kick near the sideline to St. Pauli.
6' The Freiburg players are exchanging some short passes.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! St. Pauli will take the kick-off.
Timo Gerach is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
